instruction: You are given two complete FLORIS jobs, /home/user/Desktop/job_baseline.py and /home/user/Desktop/job_yaw.py. They use two nrel_5MW turbines at (0,0) and (630,0) m, wind direction 270 deg, wind speed 8 m/s, and turbulence intensity 0.06. The baseline uses zero yaw; job_yaw applies +15 deg yaw to the upstream turbine and 0 deg to the downstream turbine. Work from the command line. Write /home/user/Desktop/run_pipeline.py to run the jobs serially and require baseline.csv and yaw.csv. Write /home/user/Desktop/compare.py to read each total power and downstream-turbine power, compute percent gains (yaw-baseline)/baseline*100, and write exactly four CSV rows to /home/user/Desktop/comparison_report.txt: baseline,total_kw,downstream_kw; yaw,total_kw,downstream_kw; Gain_Total_Percent,value; Gain_Downstream_Percent,value. Run both scripts. Do not use a GUI.
